statement_en: Let $f:\mathbb{N}\to \mathbb{C}$ be a function of subpolynomial growth, meaning that $f(n)\lesssim_{\varepsilon,f} n^{\varepsilon}$ for every natural number $n$ and every $\varepsilon>0$. Let $F(s)$ denote the Dirichlet series on the half-plane $\{\operatorname{Re}(s)>1\}$ given by $$F(s):=\sum_{n\geq 1} \frac{f(n)}{n^s}.$$ Then for every positive non-integer real number $x$ and every $\sigma>1$, one has $$\sum_{n\leq x}f(n)=\frac{1}{2\pi i }\lim_{T\to \infty}\int_{\sigma-iT}^{\sigma+iT}F(s)\frac{x^s}{s}\,ds.$$
callout_body: $f:\mathbb{N}\to \mathbb{C}$是一个亚多项式增长的函数，也就是说满足$f(n)\lesssim_{\varepsilon,f} n^{\varepsilon}$对任意自然数$n$以及$\varepsilon>0$。令$F(s)$表示在右半平面$\{\text{Re}(s)>1\}$上的Dirichlet级数$$F(s):=\sum_{n\geq 1} \frac{f(s)}{n^s}$$那么对于任意非整数的正实数$x$，以及$\sigma>1$成立公式$$\sum_{n\leq x}f(n)=\frac{1}{2\pi i }\lim_{T\to \infty}\int_{\sigma-iT}^{\sigma+iT}F(s)\frac{x^s}{s}\,ds$$
